name: Page
use: name a screen or a sheet, once, at the top of its header
notUse: a block inside the page (use Section) or a run of rows (use Group); a page heading never takes an icon, meta or action

name: Section
use: name one block above its panel, with an optional icon, a count or time (meta) for the whole block, and one link-out action
notUse: a screen or sheet title (use Page) or a label inside one panel (use Group); never two headings over one block, and never for an empty block (leave it out)

name: Group
use: label a run of rows or log entries inside one panel (Day 2, Today, Health)
notUse: a block title (use Section); it takes no icon, meta or action, and is not called on its own: reach it through rowGroup or Log
